'''Fixer 88''' was the codename of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who worked as a [[Fixer (Imperial Intelligence)|Fixer]] in the employ of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fixer 88 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP gear vendor for the Imperial Agent class on Vaiken Spacedock. A later update changed her armor, mistakenly rendering her exposed skin as a Human's.<ref name="TOR" /> She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
